claim: The active model scores a fixed-K tree topology and clone-specific local-fraction vector, while SMC stores and explores only T plus eta; SNV assignment and genotype/multiplicity uncertainty are marginalized in the likelihood.

semantic_contract.unique_claim: The model defines a collapsed score for a candidate particle state T plus eta, and annealed SMC explores, reweights, rejuvenates, and retains many such states. z_i and g_i are latent quantities in the joint model but are not persistent particle variables.
semantic_contract.reading_order: Read the left model panel from candidate state through derived CCF and likelihood-side marginalization to the collapsed score; then read the right inference panel from particle population through score, resampling/rejuvenation, retained posterior particles, and summaries.
semantic_contract.visual_encoding: Blue frames identify model semantics, teal frames identify SMC operations, purple marks likelihood-side latent quantities and derived CCF, and orange marks posterior summaries. Tree edges encode parent-descendant relation only; their length encodes neither time nor fraction. Candidate-tree images are categorical examples, not posterior estimates.
semantic_contract.state_rule: For one fixed K run, the persistent SMC particle state is T plus eta, with eta_v greater than zero and sum_v eta_v equal to one. phi/CCF is derived as a descendant sum. SMC weights, beta, and ancestors are algorithmic bookkeeping, not biological variables.
semantic_contract.latent_rule: The joint model contains z_i (SNV-to-clone assignment) and g_i (CN-aware genotype/timing and multiplicity candidate). The active particle score sums over z_i and g_i, so neither is stored as a per-particle state dimension.
semantic_contract.formula_rule: The displayed collapsed likelihood is schematic but exact in its boundaries: P(D_i|T,eta) equals a sum over z_i of eta_z times a sum over g_i of P(g_i|C_i) times the Binomial emission evaluated at xi_i(g_i,phi_z).
